item.title: Refactor orders status strings into OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate to use a typed order status, preserving existing observable behavior.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returning exactly "pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled" for their corresponding variants. Implement Display with the same output.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError. ParseStatusError must be public, implement std::error::Error, and its message must name the rejected input.
- Implement OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool with exactly these allowed transitions: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root; use the enum everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes.
- Commit the completed work on the task branch. Do not push or merge.

stages.summary: Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal: replace order status strings with public OrderStatus and ParseStatusError while preserving observable lifecycle, errors, report format/order, and parsing; the brief allows only that representation/API change and specifies the enum’s transition semantics. Original baseline: 35fdab326828f9764b12f36170f4931be3c41a61. Added deterministic integration coverage only in tests/orders.rs and committed separately as 303b6bc8304dcae8262a226bcd063150066c3acd (test: characterize order status behavior); production code remains unchanged. Coverage now pins cancellation/open behavior, rejected payment/shipping exact errors and no mutation, report parse errors/whitespace normalization, sorted status counts and input-order shipment IDs, in addition to existing lifecycle/report coverage. Baseline before tests: cargo test PASS (3 integration tests); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt -- --check FAILS on pre-existing formatting in billing.rs, order.rs, report.rs, shipping.rs and existing tests/orders.rs. After adding tests: cargo test PASS (7 integration tests); cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings PASS; cargo fmt -- --check still fails on those pre-existing formatting differences. git diff --check passed. No README, contributor docs, Makefile, CI config, library entrypoints beyond src/lib.rs and public module APIs; Cargo.toml defines a standalone Rust 2021 crate and no other checks. Public surface to compare: Order { id, customer, total_cents, status: String }, Order::new/is_open/cancel, billing::pay/outstanding_cents, shipping::ship/ready_to_ship, report::status_counts/to_line/from_line and their error strings/output sorting and order. Known coverage gap: no CLI or external wire protocol exists; CSV parsing remains only four comma-separated fields without escaping, and no tests currently stress integer overflow or embedded commas. Feedback was empty on attempt 1. Worktree is clean on task branch. Last verified tree: 9fe295e5ecba11b150ba7da8a06c08096d13a41a.
